C x.map-kind-placement EX - MUST ;; Place instruction content by Kind: OP (CLAUDE.md, always; only agent-behaviour policy needed at planning time), DEC (single decision register with D-xx IDs, optional ADRs in docs/decisions/; changed via architecture-decision), STD (normative rules per scope in .claude/rules/<scope>/<topic>.md, path-scoped), KNW (technique/examples in skills, on demand), WF (procedures in skills/agents), ENF (settings, hooks, scripts, root build/format assets), IN (product inputs; product content only, never engineering policy). ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system placement rules.
C x.map-conformance-rules EX - MUST ;; Conformance dependencies point WF → KNW → STD → DEC → OP and ENF → STD/DEC; enforcement declares its conformance in its header and 'Conforms to:' lines; other references are routing pointers only in the listed forms; a skill's references/ files are read only by that skill; standards cite decision IDs instead of restating decisions; decision summaries exist only in the register. ;; = ;; none ;; Instruction-system conformance rules.
C x.map-scope-globs EX - MUST ;; Standard path globs stay inside their scope territory (common any; backend backend/ and root .NET build files; backend-tests backend/ test paths; frontend frontend/; delivery Docker/Compose/CI paths); repo/meta has no standards. ;; = ;; none ;; Scope-territory rule.
